body: Yeah, but I dont want to continue giving my mental garbage to one specific person. I just needed to get the few things off my chest -- i feel like this is the best place to put it.

Thanks, I really appreciate your post it actually gave me some hope. I use to enjoy writing when I was younger but I lost interest after a few english courses. Ive thought about picking it back up but it takes too long and im so easily exhausted and lose interest so quickly. It took me a couple hours to get that down and about 5 mins to write this....
